arStrings.szText: Thwart the Úllo Sar and learn what they are summoning.

The Úllo Sar are recruiting among the people for their murderous plot. While I seek out and stop their rituals, Dannica will spread the word and garner what support she can. We must give people reason to hope.

Find and kill a Realmwalker by closing
{icon:Marker_Rupture_Mid_S14_Season, 2.5}Surging Ruptures in Helltide Local Events
Or investigate the {icon:Marker_Realm_Walker_S14_Season, 2.5}Colossal Rupture that sometimes opens near Zarbinzet

The audacity of the Úllo Sar goes far deeper than I could have guessed. Not only have they harnessed Realmwalkers for their madness, they have torn their way into another realm. And inside, they have awakened something dark. It saw me...spoke to me. I must speak with Dannica about this.

The Úllo Sar are recruiting among the people for their murderous plot. While I seek out and stop their rituals, Dannica will spread the word and garner what support she can. We must give people reason to hope.
I've slain the Realmwalker, and a portal has opened on its corpse. I'm not sure where this one leads. Only one way to find out.
Enter the Deathtoll Chamber opened by a slain Realmwalker
Disrupt the ritual in the Deathtoll Chamber
